name: GDevelop
description: GDevelop's desktop app uses electron-updater, while the reviewed extension-store context prefetches registry metadata and carries each extension's URL and version into its installation/update state. This snapshot does not establish an artifact hash or signature check in that application context; delegated service and dependency controls remain unresolved.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; the extension-store service, downloaded artifact format, and delegated dependency enforcement were not audited, so a repository-wide absence of hash/signature controls is not established.
